history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

The 3-bedroom Type A is 900 sq ft, with 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor, helping keep circulation space down. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq ft including sinking fund, so about RM162/month for a 900 sq ft unit. That’s maintenance only; it excludes any mortgage, utilities and pay-per-use clubhouse facilities. I’ll check the current Type A pricing so I can give you a more useful estimate if you’d like to include a mortgage instalment too.

Thanks, that gives me a clearer idea of the monthly maintenance. We’re looking for our own home, so please check the current Type A price and any other regular charges. It would help us work out the overall costs before we go further.

That makes sense—you’ll want the full picture before deciding whether it fits your budget. The confirmed maintenance is RM162/month for Type A, including sinking fund; clubhouse use is pay-per-use. Those details are being verified, and once confirmed I can help you work out the overall monthly costs.
